title: Expressions of Interest | Civil + Water Team
content_text:
Expressions of Interest | Civil + Water Team
Brisbane, QLD, Australia. Fulltime. Civil & Water Engineering.

We love to hear from those interested in working for Bligh Tanner. We often make room for those that match our values and are always eager to hear from those interested in joining our team.

Apply via the HR Partner portal: upload resume and cover letter (undergraduates also upload transcripts). Form asks about work authorisation, visa sponsorship, medical conditions, pre-employment medical willingness, workers compensation history, and a brief statement why you are applying.

Bligh Tanner is a Brisbane engineering consultancy with Civil + Water, Structural and Facade teams.
apply_instructions: Apply via HR Partner portal form at the job URL (resume + cover letter PDF/DOC; undergraduates upload transcripts).
screening_questions: Are you authorised to work in this country?
Do you have, or have you previously had, a medical condition, injury, illness, allergy or infection that could affect your ability to carry out the role or attend work regularly?
If needed, are you willing to complete a pre-employment medical assessment?
Have you previously made a workers compensation claim?
Briefly describe why you are applying for this position
